Subject: CatalystSI marketplace demo — preflight & fallback playbook

Team — putting this thread together to lock in logistics for the CatalystSI marketplace co-sell/demo. Key asks below and a draft runbook attached.

Quick context: CatalystSI will present the integration on our marketplace listing; they want a live demo for their North American prospect pool. We agreed to a live session (public listing) + a dry-run with our SI host.

Proposed timeline (initial):
- Dry-run (private rehearsal with CatalystSI + Redwood ops): Apr 13, 2027 at 09:00 PT
- Main public demo/listing session: Apr 15, 2027 at 10:00 PT

Primary asks:
1) Vanessa — will you own the marketplace listing update & pre-demo assets (blurb, screenshots, Doc link)?
2) Vivek — can you be the backup SI host if Catalyst's lead is unavailable?
3) Karthik — help confirm routing/orchestration constraints (canary model routing + fallback to smaller quantized variant).

Attached: catalyst_demo_runbook_draft.pdf (draft runbook), link to runbook in Drive. I'll follow up with calendar invites once we confirm.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

Irene — thanks for the runbook. Two quick things from our side:

1) Our primary SI lead, Marco Santori, just booked mandatory travel on Apr 15 for a prior POC sign-off and can't host the live session that day.
2) We can do the dry-run, but need to move the public demo either to Apr 16 or we need Redwood to provide a backup SI host for the 15th.

Options we can support:
- Option A: Dry-run Apr 13 09:00 PT, live demo Apr 16 10:00 PT (CatalystSI host)
- Option B: Dry-run Apr 13 09:00 PT, live demo Apr 15 10:00 PT with Redwood backup host

We're flexible on regional timing. If you can confirm a backup host for the 15th we can keep that date. Otherwise, Apr 16 works for us.

Also attaching Catalyst_POC_requirements.xlsx — small list of network/firewall checks our demo needs.

Thanks, Daniel — appreciate the heads up. I'm proposing a short fallback playbook so we don't block the marketplace listing cadence. Key points below:

Fallback playbook (short):
- If CatalystSI host unavailable for main demo: Redwood will provide backup host (Vivek) and we will enable canary routing to a quantized model variant to guarantee latency/SLOs.
- Dry-run: move earlier to Apr 14 09:00 PT (to give one more rehearsal day) OR keep Apr 13 if you prefer — please confirm ASAP.
- Marketplace listing: Vanessa to refresh blurb + one-line host note ("Hosted in partnership with Redwood Inference and CatalystSI — backup host may be Redwood personnel").
- Obligations: Catalyst needs to complete the POC network checklist 48 hours before the dry-run.

Vanessa — can you confirm marketplace copy and that the console listing can show the backup-host flag? Karthik — what's the earliest we can enable canary routing and verify kernel selection for the smaller variant? Vivek — are you OK to be on standby for the live session (we'd only route to you if Marco can't make it)?

I'll attach a short canary play and push calendar invites once we have an option selected.

Thanks all,
Irene
